what_happened.task: Fixing awal rollback bug and docker dependency

what_went_well: Identified the command structure flaw in awal
what_went_wrong: The CLI tool npx awal trade takes token amount as the first argument, not fiat amount. Passing fiat amount would have dumped all held tokens.
npx wasn't installed in the runtime docker image.
key_insights.root_cause: Misunderstanding of the `npx awal trade <amount> <asset1> <asset2>` syntax.
